question: Which team won the 2025 NBA championship, and who was the Finals MVP?
text: The **Oklahoma City Thunder** won the 2025 NBA championship, defeating the Indiana Pacers in seven games. Thunder guard **Shai Gilgeous-Alexander** was named Finals MVP. ([nba.com](https://www.nba.com/playoffs/2025/nba-finals?utm_source=openai))
